## More human widget showcases

- Widget videos now prove one behavior in one concrete task. They open on the visible result, keep the app moving, and show one short source excerpt.
- The Plotly starter is a complete runnable example. It updates the existing `FigureWidget` in place, so Plotly keeps its hover and legend controls.
- The starter includes a 45-second conversational narration target, cue-aligned actions, a hidden modebar, and portrait and landscape source cards.
- New contract tests keep the narration, cues, source excerpt, and both skill copies aligned. They also verify that both code cards fit.

This release includes both skill variants.
